name: Incline Dumbbell Tate Press
description: The Tate press performed on an incline bench, shifting the angle of triceps recruitment. The incline creates a greater stretch position for the long head of the triceps. This variation challenges coordination and targets the triceps from a fresh angle.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Incline Dumbbell Tate Press in the appropriate position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare equipment and body position for Incline Dumbbell Tate Press.
steps: Step 1: Set bench to 30-45 degree incline. Lie back holding dumbbells with elbows wide.
Step 2: Lower dumbbells in Tate arc toward upper chest with elbows flared.
Step 3: Lightly touch upper chest region at bottom of arc.
Step 4: Press back to straight arms through tricep drive.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale during the exertion phase, inhale during the return.
safety_considerations: Keep joints aligned throughout the movement.
Use controlled weight appropriate for skill level.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Move through full range of motion without compromising joint integrity.
coaching_cues: Adjust angle to feel long head stretch
